messages:
nora: Customer hit a blocked BYOK rewrap during a planned DR cutover. They say they did nothing unusual. 403 from our proxy.
raj: can you paste the proxy line + req id?
nora: log snip:
```
2026-06-10T08:12:03Z ERROR hsm-proxy req=px7 region=ap-northeast-1 code=403 msg=\"attestation verification failed: fingerprint mismatch\" incoming_fp=sha256:Zz9a outgoing_fp=sha256:Yy8b
```
ops-oncall: tenant record shows stored_fp=sha256:Yy8b. Proxy correctly rejected px7. I also see a maintenance event 08:00 that rotated proxy nodes.
ida: two hypotheses: (A) customer rotated their operator key or re-imported HSM shards without re-attesting, (B) our maintenance incorrectly updated cached fingerprint. Need evidence bundle for compliance.
sec-bot: :rotating_light: INCIDENT CREATED INC-2026-0610-BYOK-REWRAP (sev=medium)
raj: evidence we can produce quickly: import transaction (timestamp + txn id), attestation verification result at import, proxy verification log for req px7 (redact hostnames), RBAC audit lines showing which principal called custody:rotate, and a signed timeline CSV.
ops-oncall: running a quick grep for any rewrap-accept with mismatched fingerprint in the last 60 days. ETA 20m.
ida: RBAC recommendation: do not widen long-lived custody:rotate rights. Implement a JIT grant that requires an attestation proof and an approval token, at minimum for cross-region rewraps.
nora: customer asked who is responsible. We should wait for the reconciliation sweep before attributing blame. Once we have the bundle we can show timeline and determine whether customer operations or our maintenance caused the mismatch.
ops-oncall: sweep done: no instances of fp-mismatch -> allow in last 60d. Attestation present at import and validated. Candidate cause: customer re-imported HSM with new operator key in the DR region without updating attestation.
ida: I'll open a ticket to prototype short-lived custody grants and link to this incident. raj, please coordinate the evidence export and legal for retention period if customer requests >12 months.
raj: will do. Export ETA 5h. Scheduling compliance call after bundle prepared. (thumbsup)
